Bug_Title: Virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using virtual threads to execute tasks that include synchronized code. Specifically, the showBug1 and showBug2 methods start virtual threads that contain synchronized blocks and synchronized methods, respectively.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the methods showBug1 and showBug2 on an instance of VirtualThreadSynchronizationBug. These methods start virtual threads that contain synchronized blocks and synchronized methods, which violates the rule that virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code.
